nodes.description: _owner: private owner address of Ownable, controls onlyOwner gated functions
Owner: public mirror of _owner, also set/zeroed by ownership functions
_router: private mapping(address => uint256) holding all token balances
_allowances: nested mapping storing ERC20 approval amounts
router: address set by setrouteChain, treated as the sell/liquidity destination in _transfer
caller: privileged address whitelisted through Approve, exempts sender from the rTotal sell limit
_totalTokens: tracked total supply, mutable by increaseAllowance
rTotal: sell amount cap consumed in _transfer, reset by decreaseAllowance
_name: token name string 'FortuneCat'
_symbol: token symbol emoji string
_decimals: token decimals, 18
msg.sender as returned by Context._call(), the only untrusted input in this contract
Address.sendValue performs recipient.call{value: amount}('') low-level value transfer before any state settlement
Address._functionCallWithValue performs target.call{value: weiValue}(data) low-level call with user supplied data
Address.isContract: extcodehash based contract check used to gate low-level calls
Address.sendValue: internal value sender wrapping an unchecked low-level call
Address.functionCall overloads delegating to _functionCallWithValue
Address._functionCallWithValue: private helper executing the raw call and bubbling revert data
SafeMath.add: checked uint256 addition
SafeMath.sub: checked uint256 subtraction, reverts on underflow
SafeMath.mul: checked uint256 multiplication
SafeMath.div: checked uint256 division
SafeMath.mod: checked uint256 modulo
Context._call: returns msg.sender, used everywhere instead of direct msg.sender reads
Ownable.renounceOwnership: onlyOwner, zeroes _owner and public Owner
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner, reassigns _owner to newOwner
Ownable constructor: sets _owner and Owner to _call(), emits OwnershipTransferred
FortuneCat constructor: mints the entire _totalTokens balance to _call() in _router
name(): returns _name
symbol(): returns _symbol
decreaseAllowance(uint256): onlyOwner, overwrites rTotal with amount*10**18, controls sell cap
balanceOf(address): reads _router balance
transfer(address,uint256): ERC20 transfer delegating to _transfer with _call() as sender
increaseAllowance(uint256): onlyOwner, mints unlimited new supply to the owner
Approve(address): onlyOwner backdoor setting the privileged caller address
setrouteChain(address): onlyOwner setter for the router/sell-target address
decimals(): returns _decimals
allowance(address,address): reads _allowances
approve(address,uint256): ERC20 approval delegating to _approve
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): moves tokens and decrements allowance
totalSupply(): returns _totalTokens
_transfer: internal balance mutation, enforces sender!=0, recipient!=0, amount<rTotal for sells
_approve: private allowance writer, requires non-zero owner and spender
amount parameter of decreaseAllowance, scaled by 10**18 into rTotal
sender parameter of _transfer
recipient parameter of _transfer
amount parameter of _transfer, subtracted from sender and added to recipient
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership
Uniswaprouterv02 parameter of setrouteChain stored into router
trade parameter of Approve stored into caller
spender parameter of approve
amount parameter of approve
sender parameter of transferFrom
recipient parameter of transferFrom
amount parameter of transferFrom
owner parameter of allowance
account parameter of balanceOf
local variable `call` in the Ownable constructor holding _call()
owner parameter of _approve
spender parameter of _approve
amount parameter of _approve written into _allowances

edges.reason: Context._call() returns msg.sender, the single untrusted input source
Ownable constructor reads _call() to determine the initial owner
constructor writes the returned address into _owner
constructor writes the returned address into public Owner
FortuneCat constructor mints the total supply to msg.sender via _call()
constructor credits _router[msg.sender] with _totalTokens
renounceOwnership is onlyOwner and zeroes _owner
renounceOwnership also zeroes the public Owner mirror
transferOwnership is onlyOwner and reassigns _owner
onlyOwner decreaseAllowance overwrites rTotal, the sell cap used by _transfer
onlyOwner increaseAllowance adds amount to _totalTokens supply
increaseAllowance mints amount into _router[msg.sender] without burning
increaseAllowance uses _call() as the mint recipient and spender check
onlyOwner Approve sets the privileged caller address used in _transfer
onlyOwner setrouteChain sets router, the sell detection target in _transfer
transfer delegates the state mutation to _transfer
transferFrom delegates the state mutation to _transfer
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the spender allowance
_transfer debits _router[sender] and credits _router[recipient]
_transfer compares sender against the privileged caller whitelist
_transfer compares recipient against router to detect a sell
_transfer requires the sell amount to be below rTotal
balanceOf reads the balance from _router
allowance reads the nested _allowances mapping
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances
totalSupply returns the mutable _totalTokens value
sendValue reaches the raw value call statement
_functionCallWithValue reaches the raw target.call statement
recipient.call{value:} transfers control to an arbitrary address, allowing it to reenter the calling contract
target.call{value:}(data) hands control and calldata to a user-influenced address before state settlement
_functionCallWithValue requires isContract(target) before executing the low-level call
transfer uses _call() i.e. msg.sender as the debited sender
transferFrom uses _call() as the spender whose allowance is decremented
approve uses _call() as the allowance owner
msg.sender derived address flows into _transfer as sender through transfer/transferFrom
decreaseAllowance amount parameter is multiplied by 10**18 into rTotal
sender parameter drives the debit side of _transfer
recipient parameter drives the credit side of _transfer
amount parameter is checked against rTotal and used in SafeMath sub/add
newOwner parameter is written into the privileged _owner variable
Uniswaprouterv02 parameter is stored into router, the sell-detection address
trade parameter is stored into the privileged caller variable
spender parameter flows into the allowance write
amount parameter becomes the approved allowance value
sender parameter is passed to _transfer and used for allowance keying
recipient parameter is passed to _transfer
amount parameter is subtracted from the allowance with SafeMath.sub
owner parameter is the first key of the _allowances lookup
account parameter is the key of the _router balance lookup
local call variable is assigned from _call() and written into _owner/Owner
msg.sender is captured in the local call variable inside the Ownable constructor
owner parameter is the first key written into _allowances
spender parameter is the second key written into _allowances
amount parameter is stored as the raw allowance without any sanity bound
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub to debit balances
_transfer uses SafeMath.add to credit balances
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub to decrement the allowance
increaseAllowance uses SafeMath.add for supply and balance inflation

normalization_plan.reason: Transient amount parameter of decreaseAllowance; its only semantic effect is scaling rTotal, so it folds into the function node.
Positional parameter of the internal _transfer; carries no independent semantics outside the balance update.
Positional parameter of the internal _transfer; fully described by the recipient balance credit.
Amount parameter combined with rTotal check and SafeMath ops; absorbed by _transfer.
Single-use parameter written into _owner; represented by the ownership state transition.
Only used to overwrite the router state variable; folds into the setter function.
Only used to overwrite the caller privilege variable; folds into the Approve function.
Passed directly to _approve; no independent dataflow beyond the allowance write.
Approval amount forwarded verbatim to _approve; absorbed by the approve function.
Forwarded to _transfer and used as allowance key; captured by transferFrom dataflow.
Forwarded to _transfer; no separate semantic role.
Used for Transfer and for the SafeMath.sub allowance decrement; absorbed by transferFrom.
First mapping key of a pure read function; folds into allowance.
Single mapping key of a pure read function; folds into balanceOf.
Local temporary holding _call() before assignment to _owner/Owner; no independent lifetime.
Owner key of the allowance write inside the private _approve; folds into it.
Spender key of the allowance write inside the private _approve; folds into it.
Raw allowance value written without bounds; represented by the _approve allowance write.
